code.label: identity.medical.ndc
code.why: The NDC at three lengths: five digits for a labeler, nine for a product, eleven for a package. Inferred from the values it is not read as an NDC, since only the eleven-digit package codes match finetype's NDC pattern; nominated so the column carries the NDC label, and the overrides declare the three lengths it holds.

code_display.label: identity.medical.ndc
code_display.why: The FDA's hyphenated NDC, with its labeler and product prefixes on the rows above a package. Only the package rows match finetype's NDC pattern; nominated so the column carries the NDC label, and the overrides declare the shapes it holds.

level.label: representation.text.word
level.why: A closed set of three level names, labeler, product and package.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: openFDA's last-updated date, such as 2026-10-30, used as the identifier of the snapshot, as the other code lists' release is. Stored as text, so every code list's release has one type; nominated so finetype does not type it a DATE.

text_source.label: representation.text.word
text_source.why: A closed set of one value, fda; nominated so the label does not move with the inference's confidence on a single repeated value.

description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: Free text: a labeler's name, a product's names and dosage form, or a package's description, up to 2,429 characters. Inferred, finetype reads the package descriptions as postal addresses, whose 500-character limit the longest ones break.

package_description.label: representation.text.plain_text
package_description.why: The FDA's package description, free text up to 2,429 characters. Inferred, finetype reads it as a postal address, whose 500-character limit the longest ones break.

dosage_form.label: representation.text.plain_text
dosage_form.why: The FDA's dosage form, such as TABLET, FILM COATED. Inferred, finetype reads the short forms as US state codes.

generic_name.label: representation.text.plain_text
generic_name.why: The product's nonproprietary name, often a list of ingredients, up to 512 characters. Inferred, finetype reads it as an entity name, whose 200-character limit the longest ones break.

product_id.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
product_id.why: The FDA's listing identifier, the product NDC and a labeling document's UUID joined with an underscore. Inferred it is `unknown`.
